author: Khalid El Moussaoui

steps.title: Prepare Sabouraud broth
steps.instruction: Dissolve 30 g Sabouraud dextrose broth (Merck MilliporeSigma, Cat #S3306) in 1 L Milli‑Q water, stir on a heated magnetic stirrer for 5 min (mid‑speed, temperature set as indicated). Cover the flask with glass wool and aluminium foil, then autoclave at 121 °C for 30 min.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 30 g broth in 1 L water.
Stir for 5 min on heated magnetic stirrer (mid‑speed).
Cover with glass wool and aluminium foil.

steps.title: Aliquot and label medium
steps.instruction: After cooling, transfer 25 mL of the autoclaved medium into a sterile tube and label the tube with the strain number.

steps.title: Inoculate medium with culture
steps.instruction: Using a sterile swab or inoculation loop, gently collect the primary dermatophyte culture and dip it into the tube containing the 25 mL medium; close the tube halfway to allow gas exchange.

steps.title: Incubate culture to flocculate
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 30 °C until a visible flocculate forms (minimum 96 h; typically visible after 5 days). If no flocculate is observed, repeat the cultivation step.

steps.title: Harvest flocculate and add reagents
steps.instruction: Using a Pasteur pipette, transfer the flocculate to a PowerBead tube containing 0.1 mm glass beads (primary tube). Add 300 µL PowerBead solution and 50 µL SL solution.

steps.title: Freeze‑heat‑disrupt cycle (3×)
steps.instruction: Cool the tube in liquid nitrogen at –196 °C for 1 min, then heat in a 56 °C water bath for 10 min, and finally run the tube through a cell disruptor at maximum speed for 10 min. This three‑step cycle constitutes one round; repeat the entire cycle three times. The resulting mixture is the primary lysate.

substeps.instruction: Heat at 56 °C water bath for 10 min.
Disrupt in cell disruptor at max speed for 10 min.
Repeat the three steps a total of three cycles.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect primary lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 10 000 × g for 30 s at room temperature. Gently transfer the supernatant to a clean collection tube and discard the PowerBead tube.

steps.title: Add IRS solution and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL IRS solution to the supernatant, vortex for 10 s, then incubate at 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Second centrifugation and supernatant transfer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min at room temperature, transfer the supernatant to a new collection tube, and discard the pellet‑containing tube.

steps.title: Add SB solution and load column
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL SB solution to the supernatant, vortex for 10 s, then load approximately 700 µL of this suspension onto a silica‑membrane chromatography column.

steps.title: Wash column with CB solution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 10 000 × g for 30 s at room temperature, discard the flow‑through, then add 300 µL CB solution, centrifuge again under the same conditions, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column to remove residues
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the empty column at 10 000 × g for 30 s at room temperature to remove residual CB solution.

steps.title: Elute DNA with EB solution
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new collection tube, add 50 µL EB solution to the centre of the membrane, let stand for 1 min at room temperature, then centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 30 s to elute the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL EB solution to membrane centre.
Centrifuge 30 s at 10 000 × g to elute DNA.

steps.title: Store purified DNA
steps.instruction: Discard the column, keep the eluate (purified DNA), and store it at –80 °C for stability.

steps.title: Measure DNA purity with NanoDrop
steps.instruction: Perform a NanoDrop measurement to assess DNA purity and concentration; include a negative control that has undergone the entire extraction without dermatophyte material.

steps.title: Run NanoDrop blank and sample
steps.instruction: Launch the NanoDrop software in “nucleic acid” mode, clean the sample pedestal, place 2 µL of the negative control, click “blank”, then measure the DNA sample.
